title: Paperclip – Open-source AI orchestration
description: Paperclip is an open-source AI orchestration platform landing page with a distinctive, playful pink and white color scheme — an unusual and memorable choice for a developer tool. The design uses a minimalist approach with a large centered headline in a custom display font, accompanied by a subtle animated illustration of the paperclip mascot. Feature cards use rounded corners with soft shadows and a clean card grid. Open-source badges and GitHub stats are prominently displayed. The design uses micro-animations — the paperclip character bounces gently, cards have hover lifts, and scroll-triggered reveals. The color palette is refreshingly different for developer tools: hot pink (#FF3366) primary against clean white backgrounds, with subtle warm gray accents. The pink makes an audacious statement that the product is different from traditional orchestration tools. Typography uses a bold sans-serif for headings with clean body text. The site has a 'zero-human companies' tagline that tells you immediately what the product does.
primary_use_case: Excellent reference for developer tools and open-source platforms wanting a bold, unexpected brand color (pink) in a traditionally blue/indigo developer space.
style_vibe: Playful, bold developer tools page with hot pink branding — a refreshingly unexpected color choice in the traditionally conservative developer space.
